sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017: Benchmarks, Pricing and Setup
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is the October 17, 2026 update to DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash model, now served under the deepseek-flash API ID at unchanged prices. It exists to raise agentic and coding scores while cutting task time and output length, and its MIT-licensed weights are on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
